title: The Convenient time for the meeting
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：convenient　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 convenient 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the father wrote of ① a convenient time for the meeting in the letter, and everybody in the house said at once that it was ② more convenient than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the father, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the convenient ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most convenient time for the meeting anybody in the house had ever seen, or so the letter for September 1953 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too convenient to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the convenient ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a convenient shop on the corner, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as convenient as the shop on the corner they had once had in the old house. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was convenient or not, and he said so.

By 1966 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was ⑦ something convenient, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next house called the whole plan ⑧ quite convenient; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the letter kept the names of the convenient ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1969, year after year, she wrote of another convenient time for the meeting in the same letter, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more convenient than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most convenient shop on the corner in the whole house, she said in 1971, was the one she could never quite name; the convenient ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 方便（前置定语 a convenient time for the meeting：1959 年父亲在家书里记下的那件方便的时辰）
B. adj. 方便／便利（比较级 more convenient than：文中两处，一处比会面的时辰，一处比预想）
C. adj. 方便／便利（最高级 the most convenient：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 方便（表语 too convenient to do：母亲觉得它太方便，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 便利（前置定语 a convenient shop on the corner：叔叔把整件事称作一桩便利的铺子）
F. adj. 便利（同级比较 as convenient as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩街角的铺子相比）
G. adj. 便利（后置定语 something convenient：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 便利（受程度副词修饰 quite convenient：那位邻居的评价）

items.q: a convenient time for the meeting
the most convenient time for the meeting anybody
a convenient shop on the corner
The most convenient shop on the corner in

answers.why: convenient 意为“方便”，1959 年父亲在家书里记下的是“一件方便的时辰”，此处作前置定语 a convenient time for the meeting。
convenient 意为“方便”，此处用比较级 more convenient than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
convenient 意为“方便”，家书上 九月 那行字说它是老屋里最方便的一件，故用最高级 the most convenient time for the meeting。
convenient 意为“方便”，母亲认为这件东西“太方便了，谁也用不上”，too convenient to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
convenient 意为“便利”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩便利的铺子”，此处作前置定语 a convenient shop on the corner。
convenient 意为“便利”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩街角的铺子一样便利”，同级比较用 as convenient as。
convenient 意为“便利”，家书上那半行字要的是“便利的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something convenient。
convenient 意为“便利”，邻老屋来的那位邻居认为这套计划“相当便利”，quite 修饰原级 convenient。
convenient 意为“便利”，1969 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要便利”，故用比较级 more convenient than。
convenient 意为“便利”，母亲 1971 年说的是“整个老屋里最便利的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most convenient shop on the corner。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，父亲在家书里记下了一件方便的时辰。（a convenient time for the meeting）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更方便。（more convenient than …）
母亲觉得它太方便，谁也用不上。（too convenient to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩便利的铺子。（a convenient shop on the corner）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩街角的铺子一样便利。（as convenient as …）
到了 1966 年，家书上只剩半行字：要的是一件便利的东西。（something convenient）
answers: In 1959 the father wrote of a convenient time for the meeting in the letter.
Everybody said it was more convenient than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too convenient to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a convenient shop on the corner.
He said nobody would call it as convenient as the shop on the corner they had once had.
By 1966 the letter asked for nothing but something convenient.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 convenient 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the father wrote of a convenient time for the meeting in the letter, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most convenient time for the meeting in the house, or so the letter says.
My mother thought it too convenient to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a convenient shop on the corner, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next house called the plan quite convenient, and everybody laughed.
The convenient ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
